integrity: All formulas derive from independent clique-order ranks and a quadratic hub sum; finite exact-integer enumeration independently checks 548748 vertices; asymptotics rest on standard CLT/SLLN. No independent audit.
limitations: Canonical unit incidence realization only; clique size fixed in the limit, independent clique orders under the discrete uniform-vertex measure; does not address uniform volume or Gaussian angular measure. The enclosing-radius formula is prior-covered and is used solely for geometric context. Historical priority of the new complete radial law remains provisional.
title: Exact vertex-radius spectrum and a nonconcentrating chi-square law for clique-windmill graphical zonotopes
